name: HC Internet
summary: Geelong + Surf Coast ISP (ABN 73 006 681 394, 1998-2002, via connect.com.au); later rebranded HugoNet.

events.details: Rebranded HugoNet. HugoNet's 'formerly HC Internet' footer plus HugoNet's first capture in Dec 2005 hard-evidences the HC Internet -> HugoNet rebrand c. 2005; the brief's connect.com.au citation is a red herring (that domain was always Connect Internet, Perth). rebranded as HugoNet.

refs.label: HugoNet's own 2006 footer states the rebrand outright.
First-ever HugoNet capture (21 Dec 2005), already a Geelong retail ISP using the 'hc.css' stylesheet - consistent with HC Internet being rebranded into HugoNet
